python -c "
from datetime import date
from invoicing.models import Invoice, LineItem, compute_total
from invoicing.fees import late_fee

# Create test invoice
invoice = Invoice('INV-001', 'Test Corp', date(2024, 1, 15), 'net30', None, [LineItem('Test Item', 1, 10000)])

print('Late Fee Functionality Demonstration')
print('====================================')
print(f'Invoice issued: {invoice.issued}')
print(f'Invoice due date: {invoice.due}')

# Calculate grand total
totals = compute_total(invoice)
print(f'Grand total: ${totals.total / 100:.2f}')

# Test cases
test_cases = [
    (date(2024, 1, 15), 'Not past due (same date)'),
    (date(2024, 2, 14), 'Not past due (due date)'),
    (date(2024, 2, 15), '1 day past due (1 period)'),
    (date(2024, 3, 16), '31 days past due (2 periods)'),
    (date(2024, 4, 16), '61 days past due (3 periods)'),
]

for test_date, description in test_cases:
    fee = late_fee(invoice, test_date)
    print(f'{description}: {fee} cents = ${fee / 100:.2f}')

print()
print('Functionality verified:')
print('✓ Returns 0 when invoice is not past due')
print('✓ Calculates periods correctly (1-30 days = 1 period, 31-60 days = 2 periods, etc.)')
print('✓ Charges monthly_rate_bp basis points of grand total per period')
print('✓ Uses existing money helpers with rounding half up')
print('✓ Clamps fee to not exceed grand total')
"
